title: Follower not getting readings
symptom: The follower device is not receiving any readings from the master, while the watch and master are fine. The follower's xDrip menu only shows 4 options. The issue persists after uninstalling/reinstalling, clearing cache, and rolling back versions. Some users also see 'Maximum Sync Queue size Exceeded' on the master.
cause: The thread identifies that the problem is likely due to Google Play services issues on the master, or a failed QR scan during follower setup, or a full sync queue. Later, it is suggested that the master/follower data transfer relies on internet connectivity, not Bluetooth.
fix: The thread provides several workarounds: clearing Google Play services data on the master, clearing xDrip app data on the master and re-setting up, changing the sync key on both devices, or using a Nightscout follower as a workaround.
settings_changed: Sync Key → new custom sync key (longer than 16 characters)
evidence_quote: I fixed the issue on the Master. Go to Settings - Apps - Xdrip - Storage - Clear Data - Then set up everything again.
